description.value: A Japanese friendship garden in Penticton celebrating the city's sister-city relationship with Ikeda, Japan. The garden features traditional Japanese garden styling and is part of the City of Penticton's parks system. A peaceful stop for touring cyclists riding through the Okanagan.
